notes:
The Default menu now offers Regular, Regular Smart, High, High Smart, Arm CVP and Wrist CVP in that order in the GUI and standalone device. High inflates to200mmHg and adds a fixed125mmHg PVR hold with the existing130mmHg approach. Regular Smart replaces Smart Const; High Smart replaces High Max Pressure, preserving their envelope-peak +5 targets, caps and80mmHg fallback.

Historical preset names remain accepted for imports. Existing custom presets that collide with a newly reserved name remain available under a distinct suffix. Simulator results recognize both smart presets and historical names. Calibration, saved PID, valve limits and estimator thresholds are unchanged.

The firmware compiles and software parity/regression checks pass. Protected flash/restore and the required ten-minute hardware soak remain pending bench confirmation; this release is not yet bench-qualified.
